body: This looks like a framework issue. The combination of zoneless and one of the animations modules (either enabled or noop) prevents the element from being removed until the next change detection. I've isolated it in the following Stackblitz: https://stackblitz.com/edit/stackblitz-starters-9p2rdd?file=src%2Fmain.ts

repository.name: components

issue.body:
### Which @angular/* package(s) are the source of the bug?

core

### Is this a regression?

No

### Description

Component is removed form DOM but `ngOnDestroy` is not called

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open stackblitz
2. Click "Open dialog"
3. Click "toggle"
```
DialogDataExampleDialog ngOnDestroy
```
4. Remove `dialogRef.overlayRef.dispose();` or `@if (true)` and repeat 1-3
```
DialogDataExampleDialog ngOnDestroy
TestCmp ngOnDestroy
DialogOpenerCmp ngOnDestroy
```

### Please provide a link to a minimal reproduction of the bug

https://stackblitz.com/edit/yne7sc?file=src%2Fexample%2Fdialog-data-example.ts

### Please provide the exception or error you saw

```true
There is no exception, but there should be if calling `dispose` in ngOnDestroy is not supported
```

### Please provide the environment you discovered this bug in (run `ng version`)
